notes: CONFLICT: GSM5743575 (title 'Dxr 2 +ATc', field '- anhydrotetracycline') and GSM5743576 (title 'Dxr 3 -ATc', field '+ anhydrotetracycline') contradict; inducer_added and is_control left out for both. GSM5743573 title 'Dxr 1 -+ATc' read as +ATc (agrees with field). Strains carry degron-tagged essential DapB or Dxr plus an ATc-inducible protease: genotype_class knockdown for all (depletion system); ATc treated as inducer (treatment none). Uninduced (0 h and -ATc) samples taken as controls although the strain is not plain wild type. Strain background, phase and temperature not given.
